description: So ngay DOM toi thieu de can duoc coi la qua han ban (kich hoat ma tran chan doan).
Dung sai dien tich thong thuy khi xac lap nhom can tuong dong (peer group).
Co mau toi thieu cua peer group; duoi nguong nay mo rong sang tang lan can.
Khoang cach phong rac (met) duoi muc nay: cong 30 diem phat khuyet tat vat ly.
Khoang cach phong rac (met) duoi muc nay: cong 15 diem phat khuyet tat vat ly.
Nguong % gia so cap cao hon thu cap de kich hoat SECONDARY_ARBITRAGE.
Nguong ty so tong gia / thu nhap ho de kich hoat LUMP_SUM_TICKET_BARRIER.
Nguong % chenh gia so voi peer group de kich hoat OVERPRICED_VS_PEER.
Nguong hoa hong co ban toi da de kich hoat LOW_SALES_INCENTIVE.
Nguong ty le rut coc de kich hoat DEEP_FUNNEL_DROP_OFF.
Ty le can trong gio hang duoc gia lap chiu loi cau truc. Tu hieu chinh (khong co so lieu thuc te), can ra soat lai.
